principle: Stores POINTERS ONLY. Never store canonical source content in this repository. On any mismatch between a repository pointer and the current active source, THE LIVE DRIVE DOCUMENT WINS.

cutover.rule: The pre-cutover multi-document OS is retired. A RETIRED, LEGACY, ARCHIVED, or Superseded document is evidence only and never current authority.

resolution_rules: Resolve every source by file_id. Never resolve current authority by title search.
Reject any retrieval whose live title begins with RETIRED -, LEGACY -, or ARCHIVED -, or contains Superseded.
Read the retrieved document's own version/date/status line and compare it to version_pin when a pin exists.
version_pin mismatch => status REGISTRY DRIFT: proceed on the live document, raise an Improvement Finding, do not proceed on the pin.
Retrieval failure on a required source => HOLD for the policy-dependent portion of the task only.
Access is proven by retrieval, never inferred from repository visibility or folder sharing.

authority_levels.controlling: The active lifecycle SOP or system runbook controlling the workflow.
authority_levels.supporting: An active playbook, competency map, or project instruction used within its scope.
authority_levels.template: An approved master used to create a client-specific derivative; never overwrite the master.
authority_levels.runtime-control: The active runtime phase, hold, and certification control record.
authority_levels.runtime-registry: The staged Authority, Capability, Entity, Execution Contract, and Certification registries.
authority_levels.evidence: A cutover or certification record; evidence, not business procedure.
